summary: Dry-run previews show the full endpoint path, redacting every route-template parameter position to :id regardless of its value, so subresources like /metrics or /publish stay visible.
reason: The shared endpoint classifier keeps only two path segments for rate-limit budgets, so dry runs of subresource calls looked like plain collection calls (GET /v1/campaigns for campaign metrics). Redaction must be positional, not value-based, because a private value can equal a route word (an event named publish); unmatched paths fail closed.
validated_outcome: campaigns metrics get <id> --dry-run reports GET /v1/campaigns/:id/metrics; a test fails if any pp:path route word is missing from the allowlist.
